title: 32 km inversion, 10 TAO iterations under scpc_gamg on 8 ranks, sub-element friction and five solves an evaluation, with ISMIP7SCPC.destroy
mesh: antarctica_320000_32000_buffered0 (Quartz's .msh, sha256 fd66fc42; 6,282 vertices, 9,055 cells), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling
initial_state: cold start: u = 0.1 u_obs, theta = phi = 0, the n,m 1 to 3 ramp under full_mumps, then ISMIP7_EVAL_CONTINUATION=1 (five annotated solves an evaluation)
forcing: MEaSUREs v2 450 m (sha256 268be94e) and BedMachine v4.1 (sha256 6bd08dbb); ISMIP7_FLUIDITY_PRIOR=legacy; bi-Laplacian prior; no dH/dt term
site: IU workstation (Mac, 16 cores, 128 GB), data under /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_obs; no other session's simulation in its 10 s CPU log (foreign_cpu.txt: Time Machine, WindowServer, Defender and the desktop apps, each at most about one core)
resources: 8 ranks; RSS a rank (mean over ranks) 1024.4 MiB after the first iteration, 1036.5 after the 11th record: 8.1 MiB at the second record, then 0.45 MiB an iteration; peak 1834 MiB
cost: 808 s wall, 10 iterations (12 evaluations): 63.1 s an iteration (median after the first)
audit: same iterations as test-32km-inversion-scpc-destroy-tao-before, every objective within 7.1e-11 (last 2.507499e4); published residual 279.6 after a 0-iteration final solve; no forward failed
notes: ISMIP7_SUBELEMENT_FRICTION=1 (exact front push on) ISMIP7_GRAD_PRECOND=mass_consistent ISMIP7_PRIOR_FORM=bilaplacian, the configuration of test-32km-inversion-reuse-tao-after-rerun; the TAO path writes rss_mib once an accepted iteration, after that iteration's last adjoint; run with code archived from the commit (git archive), no wrapper
